resources.name: tribes_orgs.csv
resources.title: Toronto civil-society organization registry
resources.description: One row per organization in the Toronto civil-society registry behind unitetolove.ca's Organization Directory, each holding a permanent org_id. This download carries only rows we have confirmed directly (verification_status 'verified-live'), and matches the live directory page at https://unitetolove.ca/tribes/directory.html row for row. A further 17,044 organizations are recorded in the underlying registry but withheld from publication because our verification of them is weaker: publishing a 'closed' or 'unreachable' claim about a named third-party organization is not retractable once copied, so we publish only what we have checked. The withheld counts are disclosed by status at https://unitetolove.ca/commons.html#orgs. Coverage is partial and uneven across categories; assembled from the project's own original field research, not a re-publication. As of 2026-08-16.

fields.name: org_id
fields.description: Permanent registry identifier, ORG-##### (zero-padded 5-digit), minted once in insertion order and never reused or reassigned.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The organization's name as recorded in the registry.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Top-level category, a controlled-vocabulary slug assigned by the registry's own taxonomy (e.g. "base-of-pyramid", "neighbourhood-association-federation"). Left as the raw slug, not prettified.

fields.name: subcategory
fields.description: Free-text or slug subcategory refining category; specificity varies row to row.

fields.name: area
fields.description: Free-text geography note, NOT a structured ward/riding join — values range from a ward name to a full qualifying sentence. The registry has no dedicated geography dataset yet; treat this column as a hint, not a filter key. Blank where no area is on file.

fields.name: website
fields.description: The organization's public website, extracted as the first http(s) link found in the source record. Blank where no public website is on file. Never an email address or phone number.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.description: Where this row's information currently stands: verified-live (checked and reachable), seed-web-verified (added, not yet through a verification pass), seed-unverified, dormant, unreachable, defunct, or dead-no-successor. Broader than the live directory page, which renders only verified-live rows.

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this row was last checked, where the registry recorded one. Blank where no date is on file — never guessed.
